q: Does ferromolybdenum from Armenia face EU CBAM?
title: Armenian ferromolybdenum: CBAM check
short: No, not under the current goods list. CBAM covers ferro-manganese, ferro-chromium and ferro-nickel among ferroalloys; ferro-molybdenum (CN 7202 70) is not listed. EU steel mills may still ask for a figure for their own Scope 3, so keep fuel, power and production records.
audience: Ferroalloy producers in Armenia and EU steel buyers

p: The Commission has proposed extending CBAM to more downstream goods. Check the adopted annex each year.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, power and production records into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions your EU importer asks for.

sources.label: European Commission, CBAM legislation and guidance
